verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say teams collaborate "with your team and auditor in-platform" and include an audits section on selecting an audit partner. That supports the core idea that auditors work inside the platform rather than over email. The evidence does not describe a dedicated auditor role or how auditors view controls and evidence. Missing for 10: documentation of a scoped auditor role/view with access limited to controls and evidence, detail on how auditors review and comment on evidence in-platform, independent or hands-on corroboration.
